bifrost: springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs (Manifest), springboard/src/shell/store/install.rs (parse_manifest, install_archive), springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (Policy::with_entitlements, Policy::from_permissions, prepare_data), springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs (Bundle, set_main_bundle), springboard/ui/src/launch.rs (Handler), springboard/sdk/src/workspace.rs
summary: BifrOSt covers the app package manifest, permission and entitlement gating, a fixed package layout and localized string bundles. It has no Info.plist, no privacy manifest for declaring collected data or required-reason APIs, and no universal links (applinks) service.

features.apple: Entitlements (com.apple.security.* keys in a signed entitlements file)
features.note: Only the log-store entitlement exists. It is honoured only for is.olibuijr.* packages of kind system-app. Entitlements are a manifest list, not a signed file.

features.feature: Information property list (bundle identity and configuration)
features.apple: Information Property List (Info.plist): CFBundleIdentifier, CFBundleVersion, CFBundleURLTypes, CFBundleDocumentTypes
features.note: manifest.toml carries id, name, version, exec, icon, min_shell, summary, category, permissions, window and kind. It is TOML, not a plist. There are no per-language InfoPlist strings and no plist-based bundle keys.

features.apple: Privacy manifest files (NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes and tracking declarations), with the app's permission use listed in the bundle
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (Policy::from_permissions: network, storage, audio, notifications, documents, keychain, remote-desktop)
features.note: Apps declare permissions in manifest.toml and the shell enforces them. Unknown permission names are rejected. Nothing is shown to the user as a privacy label, and no tracking domains are declared.

features.feature: Privacy manifest: data collection and required-reason API declarations
features.apple: Privacy manifest files: App Privacy Configuration, collected data types, required reason APIs
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No file describes the data an app collects or the reason it uses a required-reason API. springboard/core/src/log.rs has a <private> redaction marker for log values; it is not a manifest declaration.

features.feature: Placing content in a bundle (package layout)
features.apple: Placing content in a bundle: fixed locations for executables, resources, frameworks and plug-ins
features.note: A .aap is a tar with manifest.toml, the exec binary, the icon and an optional assets/ tree. It installs under apps/<id>/<version> with a current symlink. No placement rules for frameworks or plug-ins.

features.apple: Container directories in the app sandbox (Library, Documents, Caches)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (prepare_data); springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs (shell data dir as apps' asset dir); springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs (document grants)
features.note: Each app gets a data directory owned by its account. Files outside it need a document grant from the shell. There is no Library, Caches or Documents split.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Reads <app>/<lang>.lproj/Localizable.strings with en fallback, as documented in docs/bifrost-ui.md. Built-in formatting data covers en and is only. No asset catalogs, storyboards or nib-style resources.

features.feature: URL schemes and document types declared by the app
features.apple: CFBundleURLTypes and CFBundleDocumentTypes in Info.plist; Launch Services handler registry
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/launch.rs (Handler::opens, Handler::scheme); springboard/src/shell/defaultapps.rs (builtin handlers); springboard/sdk/src/workspace.rs (open); wired: springboard/src/shell/defaultapps.rs (manifest_handler, Email category)
features.note: The registry and default-app choice exist. docs/default-apps.md says open-url routing by scheme and the Open With menu are not done. Only http and https reach the browser through packaging/arch/wayland/open-url. URLType (CFBundleURLTypes: name, schemes, role, rank) parses in bundle_resources.rs and the launch service answers application_for_url (declaring app plus all candidates, user default first). No universal links. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: applinks: apple-app-site-association domain verification that routes https links to the app
features.note: No domain association file, no verification and no https link routing to a non-browser app. The browser claims http and https by default (springboard/src/shell/defaultapps.rs builtin).

gaps: No privacy manifest: an app cannot declare the data it collects or its required-reason API use (Privacy manifest files).
No universal links service: https links cannot be routed to an installed app by domain association.
No Info.plist equivalent with CFBundle-style keys; manifest.toml is the only identity file and it is not a plist.
URL-scheme routing by the shell is not wired for non-web schemes (docs/default-apps.md, Not done yet).
Entitlements are limited to log-store; there is no general entitlements file and no signing.
No documented placement rules for frameworks or plug-ins inside an app package.
